newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nackebro bids for rival Fabege.
newsitem.headline: Nackebro bids for rival Fabege.

text.p: Swedish real estate company Nackebro on Wednesday bid 85 crowns per share for rival Fabege, in the wake of a bid by Hufvudstaden, another real estate company.
The offer corresponded to a 26 percent premium on the Fabege price on May 14 and a 15 percent premium on June 3, after the Hufvudstaden bid was announced, Nackebro said in a statement.
The bid, worth a total of 2.2 billion crowns, would be financed by cash and loans, it said.
Hufvudstaden said in May it would buy Fabege with 11 Hufvudstaden A series shares for five Fabege shares, which corresponded then to a 12 percent premium.
Nackebro managing director Lennart Schonning told Reuters he expected the bid to be successful.
"I am convinced that we have good chances to see the bid through. I have difficulty seeing how the board can recommend the Hufvudstaden bid for Fabege as our bid actually is higher," Schonning said.
